# Kurgo

> > Kurgo is a leading dog travel and outdoor gear brand dedicated to helping dogs travel safely and comfortably with innovative products backed by a lifetime warranty.

Founded in 2003, Kurgo specializes in dog harnesses, travel accessories, and outdoor gear designed for safety and adventure. The company serves customers across the US, Canada, Europe, and beyond with comprehensive customer support, warranty coverage, and educational resources.
